checks: Migration installs empty database and repeats without changes
Explicit administrator setup is idempotent
Startup validation verifies applied migrations, required tables and active admin
SEO export contains real seeded profile, indexable URLs and working favicon without artificial lastmod
Anonymous requests cannot access portal or administration; deep links are preserved
Per-response CSP nonce matches every script, cannot be supplied by clients and is not cached
Successful shared-IP logins do not exhaust the failed-login quota; repeated failures remain blocked
Case-insensitive login, persistent cookie and admin page
User and public profile created atomically; duplicate emails roll back
RBAC, self-demotion prevention and CSRF rejection
Multipart upload, real image decoding, durable storage, profile display and ETag
Stored advisor content cannot break out of JSON-LD; repeated profile query parameters render safely
Corrupt images and unauthorized uploads rejected
Lead submission, confirmation validation, ownership and audit notes
Advisors cannot read applications or take another advisor’s assigned lead
Team chat saves and retrieves messages
Referral registration requires consent; private token is hashed and public code cannot read status
Referral attribution is optional, excludes self-referrals and counts duplicate email once
Referral dashboard counts follow actual portal status; shared routes render
Rendered public pages have one H1, bounded metadata, route canonicals, social images, theme color and image alt attributes
24 public pages, services, repeated query parameters, admin alias and genuine 404
Server restart preserves authenticated sessions and profile image storage
Password changes revoke existing sessions
Image removal clears both profile reference and stored data
Admin deletion rejects unauthorized/self requests, revokes sessions, removes sole profile and retains private leads and chat
Referral links and counts survive server restart and unrelated account deletion
Authentication outage returns retryable API responses without clearing the session or redirecting to login; same cookie works after recovery
Logout expires the session cookie
Database failure produces server error instead of false advisor 404 or successful incomplete sitemap and recovers
